battlenet_panel.ensure_normal: Keep Battle.net normal (log in at startup and keep running)
battlenet_panel.guard_desc: From app start, keep Battle.net running and logged in: ensure the region first (CN / Asia, restart with --setregion when needed), then log in automatically (CN NetEase web / Asia form typed in), and restart by the timeout rules above.
battlenet_panel.credentials_desc: CN and Asia accounts are saved separately in the user data folder (password encrypted). Switching logs out via the avatar menu and logs in with the new account; another region restarts Battle.net with the region argument.
battlenet_panel.abnormal_restart: Restart on abnormal timeout (connecting / disconnected / login failed / stuck loading)
battlenet_panel.login_restart: Restart on login timeout (login screen / browser confirm / logging in)
battlenet_panel.region_prompt: Ask to restart Battle.net when the region changes
battlenet_panel.region_restart_ask: Region switched to {0}. Quit and restart Battle.net now with the official region argument?

decompile.tools_desc: Downloaded into the program data folder: ILSpy (.NET to C#, needs the .NET SDK), de4dot-cex (.NET deobfuscation), autoit-ripper (compiled AutoIt to .au3, needs Python), UPX (unpack). Already installed tools are kept.
decompile.rosbot_desc: Main program (deobfuscate, then decompile) plus every plugin DLL; writes settings_fields.md with all setting names (RoS-BoT.ini keys). Method bodies protected by DNGuard HVM are decrypted only at runtime and stay as stubs.
decompile.rbassist_desc: Compiled AutoIt program: extracts the .au3 script and embedded files (UPX is unpacked first when needed).
decompile.file_desc: Detects the type automatically: .NET assembly, compiled AutoIt, or native code (not supported).
decompile.recover_sources: Export available sources and attempt DNGuard recovery
decompile.chain_desc: Checks that all tools run, then decompiles configured ROSBOT, plugins and RBAssist into a new folder. Saves chain_report.json. DNGuard placeholder bodies are reported as partial recovery. Select a restored assembly under Any file to inspect an external recovery result.
decompile.passed: Chain passed: tools ran and all targets produced output without detected DNGuard placeholders.
decompile.incomplete: Chain incomplete: check the log and chain_report.json for missing tools, failed targets or protected method bodies.
